answer: Because the pigment weight is recomputed from the horizon history each close, the relic audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for each alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. A new identity spends its first 9 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 23% of full weight. That is 39 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
